en: A sepia-toned illustrated postcard depicting a historic church complex with Baroque-style towers and spires rising above attached residential-style buildings along a narrow path or lane. The scene shows windows with shutters and curtains, a vaulted passageway, and a garden-lined walkway leading toward the entrance. Handwritten-style text identifying the location appears along the bottom border.
